payload.summary: The material defect identified in the prior review has been corrected with the smallest bounded change. The plan no longer sums nominal one-group departures or describes the resulting endpoints as an enclosure. It defines A_Q as the nominal value, four coherent corners for each dependence group perturbed alone with all other groups nominal, and a separate tightened-prediction value; R_Q is exactly the observed minimum and maximum over that finite set. The comparison claims, prediction tests, validation, stop conditions, priority rationale, and value rationale all state that no disposition covers simultaneous multi-group perturbations or probabilistic coverage. The physical 2 x 2 material-by-boundary factorial and four paired tightened reruns are unchanged, so computation and cost remain aligned with the two current objectives. The supplied tables make the reference audit computable, while exact ledgers remain a mandatory stop gate. The original mandatory profile and front/tail targets are both addressed within the present bounded claims; microscopic mechanism separation remains later work under explicit adequacy and stability conditions. Execution feasibility is appropriately conditional because the supplied execution context identifies SProcess R-2020.09 but supplies no capability statements or limitations, and the visible prior initialization concerns a differently keyed realization.
